_note: pip install minihack (needs setuptools<81). Eating floor food is a TWO-step NetHack action: press E, then NetHack asks 'eat it? [ynq]' and you answer Y (yes). That confirm keystroke is why eating seems to 'freeze' after E -- you must then press Y. (NetHack draws the prompt on the tty message line, which is NOT part of the pixel observation, so it can't be shown on screen; the E-then-Y recipe in the instructions is what the player follows.) In NetHack y/n ARE the NW/SE movement keys, so the diagonal keys double as the yes/no answers (Y=act 7='y', N=act 5='n').
_keys_note: Discrete(85) full command set; we expose movement + eat. Compass 0-7 (0=N,1=E,2=S,3=W,4=NE,5=SE,6=SW,7=NW); 29=EAT. Arrows map to the cardinals, y/u/b/n to the diagonals, E to eat. Y (act 7) sends keystroke 'y'='yes' and N (act 5) sends 'n'='no' at a [ynq] prompt. turn_based:true is required -- noop is action 0 (=move N). Keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.

text: You're hungry. Walk onto the food, then eat it in
two steps:  press  E  to eat, then  Y  to confirm.
ARROWS       move  N / S / W / E
Y / U        move diagonally  NW / NE     (Y = 'yes')
B / N        move diagonally  SW / SE     (N = 'no')
E  then  Y   eat the food you're standing on
